def count_rotation(arr):
    """
    Count the number of rotations in a sorted array that has been rotated.
    The rotation count equals the number of elements after the minimum element,
    i.e., len(arr) minus the index of the minimum element.
    """
    n = len(arr)
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    lo, hi = 0, n - 1
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if arr[mid] > arr[hi]:
            lo = mid + 1
        else:
            hi = mid
    min_index = lo
    return n - min_index


assert count_rotation([3, 2, 1]) == 1
